headline: Marban Hollow Flares as Weathered Expanse and Olavis Wake Reel
war_summary: Marban Hollow has erupted into a furious battleground over the past three hours, recording seven base turnovers in the last two hours alone around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall as Wardens and Colonials split eight strategic positions. High-tempo combat also persists across Weathered Expanse and Olavis Wake, with both hexes logging fresh exchanges right up to the dispatch wire. Weathered Expanse sustained over eighteen hundred casualties in two hours while logging four additional base flips at Spirit Watch and Frostmarch, leaving three positions in ruins. In Olavis Wake, five more turnovers unfolded across Koskinla and Ilmari Bridge, though Colonials currently hold all five bases amidst intense attrition. To the north, Kuura Strand reawakened with two base exchanges, maintaining a fragmented three-two split with one neutral site, while Pari Peak and Stlican Shelf logged sporadic base contests. Conversely, the central sector at Linn of Mercy went cold with zero turnovers over the last two hours, joining Nevish Line in relative quiet, while massive casualty rates in Farranac Coast, Dead Lands, and Callahan’s Passage yielded no shifts in strategic territory.
